note: Mission 2 (Second Pulse) content: the MIDI exported to midi_export/level_02_second_pulse/ (the mission's default groove, bass line and backing as 8-bar loops, with rule-based alternatives B and C of every kick, snare and bass part), to be rendered in Ableton as WAVs named after the MIDI files. Run: python tools/content/import_ableton.py content/imports/level_02.json --check, then without --check, then python tools/content/build.py level_02. The mission is rewired to these clips in a follow-up, as mission 1 was. Names are provisional. Levels as in first_watch.json: drums and bass peak at -4 dBFS, bass RMS-matched to -17 dBFS where that peak allows, backing at -3 dBFS, then a global trim of -7 dB.

clips.name: Second Pulse Groove A
clips.note: Kick_A with Snare_A: the default groove groove_push tiled to 8 bars.

clips.name: Second Pulse Groove B
clips.note: Kick_B with Snare_B: rule-based variation of Kick_A and Snare_A (kick: a hit added, moved or dropped every two bars; snare: a ghost, a moved backbeat or a beat 4 hit).

clips.name: Second Pulse Groove C
clips.note: Kick_C with Snare_C: rule-based variation of Kick_A and Snare_A (kick: a hit added, moved or dropped every two bars; snare: a ghost, a moved backbeat or a beat 4 hit).

clips.name: Second Pulse Bass A
clips.note: Bass_A: the new root-note line (the mission has no bass phase), 8 bars.

clips.name: Second Pulse Bass B
clips.note: Bass_B: a rule-based variation of Bass_A (a note moved to the fifth or octave, a long note split or two tied), C# natural minor.

clips.name: Second Pulse Bass C
clips.note: Bass_C: a rule-based variation of Bass_A (a note moved to the fifth or octave, a long note split or two tied), C# natural minor.

clips.name: Second Pulse Backing
clips.note: Other_Pad and Other_Hats: the backing acc_second_pulse, the chords and the hi-hats rendered separately. The exported MIDI is 40 bars long (render all of it); this manifest imports the first 8 bars (bars: 8). Import the full length with a second manifest whose bars is 40.
